data.body:
Checkpoint/final status for bug 01c4-cca2-ec11-4530 (`beige-acute-bobolink`):

RCA is proven. The race was not an in-process terminal-before-emit ordering bug; `review_plan()` already emitted before the async daemon wrote the terminal gate-run record. The actual defect was missing per-run `REVIEW_RESULT` identity/readability: `sidecar.emit()` only returned a bool, the async gate-run index discarded sidecar outcome/receipt, `gate_status()` reported terminal verdict/durable attestation without proving findings readability, and `latest_review_result(ticket)` was newest-by-ticket rather than job-scoped. For BLOCK verdicts, unsigned attestation cannot prove findings readiness, so callers could silently read stale prior-run findings.

Fix landed in Gerrit change 2521. It records/carries an exact sidecar receipt (`sidecar_reviewed_at`) from `append_event()` through sidecar emit/reuse and the async gate-run index, and exposes `gate_status(job_id).findings` with `readable`, `reason`, `reviewed_at`, and diagnostic `latest_reviewed_at`. Pollers can now wait for `findings.readable=true` for the current run before reading findings; stale newest-by-ticket sidecars are not treated as current.

Current state: Gerrit change 2521 merged as `8a38aa7656d5405813a72ff3d61d4fb6f1759cfd` with `LLM-Review+1`, `Verified+1`, and zero unresolved comments. Ticket is closed as `regression`, caused by `d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231`, with certified `completion-verifier` opcert. No design-decision escalation was hit.
